lines.trans: Look, these tall glass windows face the courtyard tree!
The shutters outside are all closed, so nobody in the courtyard ever noticed!
Now I remember! When I was ten, my uncle called it the winter tea room!
Why would someone lock such a beautiful room behind a bookcase?
One spring it poured, the glass roof leaked, and nobody had money to fix it.
Manager Zhou, look at the stone floor—not one drop of water!
Whoever fixed the courtyard roof back then fixed this roof too!
Manager Zhou, how many little tables do you think fit in here?

words.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

lines.trans: Wait—to protect the old house, we promised the city a reading café!
And this is exactly the room the city letter asked for!
Warm bread, hot tea, morning sun, and not a bit of cold wind!
Wait a moment, what's under that big white cloth in the corner?

words.gloss: measure word for pieces and yuan

lines.trans: Goodbye!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí xià. Placed after an action verb to make a request or suggestion sound casual and brief (看一下, 等一下).

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì diǎn. Before a noun, means 'a little bit of' (一点糖); after an adjective, 'a bit more' (快一点).

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

examples.text: 太好了！请加牛奶和一点糖。
examples.trans: Wonderful! With milk and a little sugar, please.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最下面 ('the bottom part').

examples.text: 快拿到楼下灯光下面看看吧！
examples.trans: Let's bring it downstairs under the light and take a look!

examples.text: 志豪先生早！在木房梁下面睡得好吗？
examples.trans: Morning, Mr Zhihao! Did you sleep well beneath the wooden beams?

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.en: in order to; for the sake of
meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi le. Introduces a goal or purpose, typically at the start of the sentence.

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

examples.text: 说实话，我选这一带，也是为了一桩家里的旧事。
examples.trans: Honestly, I also chose this neighbourhood for an old family matter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi shén me. Asks for a reason; answered with 因为 ('because').

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

examples.text: 为什么把鞋和木头小火车留到星期五呢？
examples.trans: Why leave the shoes and little wooden train here until Friday?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū jià. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个书架 ('a bookcase').

examples.text: 看这个箭头——指着走廊里的书架！
examples.trans: Look at this arrow—it points at the bookcase in the hallway!

examples.text: 那个大书架靠着那面墙，已经二十年了！
examples.trans: That big bookcase has stood against that wall for twenty years!

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rén. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个人 ('a person').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǐ qián. Measure word (量词): 段, e.g. 以前的日子 ('days in the past').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 哦？您家里人以前住在这附近吗？
examples.trans: Oh? Did your family live near here once?

related.gloss: days in the past (measure word 段)

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ men. Plural 'you' for addressing two or more people (including polite groups).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎo hù. Used for protecting historic neighborhoods or people.

examples.text: 房产信？让志豪和我看看——我管市政合同，他懂老建筑保护法！
examples.trans: A property letter? Let Zhihao and me see it—I handle municipal contracts, and he knows heritage building law!

examples.text: 成都老城区保护条例第十四条——窗外我哥哥刚点头了！
examples.trans: Clause fourteen of the Chengdu Old Quarter Act—and my brother outside just nodded!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìn. Measure word (量词): 封 (fēng), e.g. 一封信 ('a letter').

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

examples.text: 周经理！您脸色全白了！快坐下——信上写了什么？
examples.trans: Manager Zhou! Your face went completely white! Sit down quickly—what does the letter say?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiū. Used for fixing pipes, locks, furniture, or appliances (修好 'fix completely').

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

meanings.note: Pinyin: guān. Used for closing doors/windows and turning off lights, taps, or valves.

examples.text: 拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
examples.trans: Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?

examples.text: 关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
examples.trans: Turned off and drained. Pass me that heavy wrench on your left.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài jiàn. Standard Mandarin farewell at any time of day.

examples.text: 路上小心，我们明天再见！
examples.trans: Take care on the road—see you again tomorrow!

examples.text: 谢谢您的帮忙，再见！
examples.trans: Thank you for your help—goodbye!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōng tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个冬天 ('a winter').

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

examples.text: 两个都买下！留一个备用明年冬天也省心。
examples.trans: Buy both! Keeping a spare saves worry next winter too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lěng. Describes cold weather, unheated rooms, or cold water.

examples.text: 热汤？在冷站台吹了风，喝碗热汤太好了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After the cold wind on the station platform, hot soup sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 那今晚房间会冷吗？也没有热水了吗？
examples.trans: Will the rooms get cold tonight? And is there no hot water either?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí. Cardinal number 10; building block for 11–99.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fā xiàn. Used when noticing a clue or uncovering an object.

examples.text: 椅子找到了——在一堵旧砖墙后面，我还发现了这个。
examples.trans: Found the chairs—and behind an old brick partition wall, I also uncovered this.

examples.text: 打扫地下室的时候，他发现了一个旧木盒。
examples.trans: While cleaning the cellar, he discovered an old wooden box.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shū shu. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位叔叔 ('an uncle').

examples.text: 我想起来了！我十岁的时候，叔叔叫它冬天茶室！
examples.trans: Now I remember! When I was ten, my uncle called it the winter tea room!

examples.text: 我叔叔在成都开了一家小饭馆。
examples.trans: My uncle runs a small restaurant in Chengdu.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiào. Introduces a person's given or full name (我叫小晴 'My name is Xiaoqing') or calls a cab.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: hòu mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最后面 ('the very back').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 志豪先生！您一直站在后面吗？！
examples.trans: Mr Zhihao! Were you standing right there behind us?!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōu. Surname of Manager Zhou (周经理); as a noun/classifier, means 'week'.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kā fēi guǎn. Measure word (量词): 家 (jiā), e.g. 一家咖啡馆 ('a café').

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

examples.text: 比现在翻一倍！我们真的要对整条街开放小院咖啡馆吗？
examples.trans: Double what I bake now! Are we really opening the courtyard café to our whole street?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dì bǎn. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块地板 ('a floorboard').

examples.text: 晚上好。不好意思，把干净地板弄湿了。
examples.trans: Good evening. Sorry for getting your clean floor wet.

examples.text: 快去跟他聊聊，小晴，不然木地板都要踩破了！
examples.trans: Go talk to him quickly, Qing, or he will wear right through the wooden floorboards!

块.gloss: measure word for pieces and yuan

meanings.en: measure word for pieces and yuan
meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. Counts chunks/pieces (一块蛋糕 'a piece of cake') and spoken yuan of money (五块钱 'five yuan').

examples.text: 钱箱里拿五十块，记得要收据！
examples.trans: Here is fifty yuan from the cash box; remember to get a receipt!

examples.text: 在这儿！一共三十八块，找回十二块零钱。
examples.trans: Right here! Thirty-eight yuan in total, with twelve yuan back in change.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 城里地方 ('a spot in town').

examples.text: 再等几分钟，志豪先生。中午城里堵车总是很慢。
examples.trans: Give it a few more minutes, Mr Zhihao. Midday city traffic is always slow.

examples.text: 他一早就坐车去城里办事了。
examples.trans: Early in the morning he rode into town on business.

related.gloss: a spot in town (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: wài mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 外面世界 ('the outside').

examples.text: 外面一模一样，可是你看里面！
examples.trans: The outside is identical, yet look inside!

examples.text: 外面下着大雨，街上酒店全满了！我们怎么办？
examples.trans: It is pouring rain outside and every hotel on the street is full! What do we do?

meanings.note: Pinyin: duō shao. Asks about larger numbers, prices, or room/phone numbers (多少钱 'how much money?').

examples.text: 等等，换房间我们给他打多少折？
examples.trans: Wait—what discount do we offer him for changing rooms?

examples.text: 小美，你的烤箱每天早上最多能烤多少肉桂卷和柠檬蛋糕？
examples.trans: Mei, how many cinnamon rolls and lemon cakes can your oven bake each morning?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà jiā. Warm collective pronoun including everyone in the group.

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tài yáng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个太阳 ('a sun').

examples.text: 热面包，热茶，早上的太阳，一点冷风也没有！
examples.trans: Warm bread, hot tea, morning sun, and not a bit of cold wind!

examples.text: 今天太阳很好，我们去院子里坐坐吧。
examples.trans: The sun is lovely today; let's go and sit in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎo. Main adjective 'good'; as a result complement after a verb, means 'ready/completed properly' (修好, 准备好).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular pronoun for objects, animals, and places.

examples.text: 是啊，宋老师，还在等它的主人呢。
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, still waiting for its owner.

examples.text: 别念叨它，宋老师！我现在差不多喜欢上那两声响了。
examples.trans: Don't tempt it, Teacher Song! I have almost grown fond of those two rings now.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì. Means 'correct!' on its own, 'right' as a result complement (拿对), or 'to/toward' before a noun.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng. Counts sealed letters and mail items (一封信 'a letter').

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

examples.text: 太好了……趁着等他们，我扫一眼这封房东来信。
examples.trans: Wonderful... while we wait, let me glance at this letter from the landlord.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo. Everyday adjective for small size; also prefixes younger colleagues' names warmly (小晴, 小美).

examples.text: 早上好，小姑娘。我订了房间，我姓宋。
examples.trans: Good morning, young lady. I booked a room; my surname is Song.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù shì. Adds emphatic certainty before a noun ('is the very one').

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 没关系！您就是志豪先生吧？
examples.trans: No problem at all! You must be Mr Zhihao, right?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wū dǐng. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个屋顶 ('a roof').

examples.text: 听屋顶上的雨声，这儿真温馨！
examples.trans: Listen to the rain on the roof—it feels so cosy up here!

examples.text: 哇……你们看这木头屋顶的比例！
examples.trans: Wow... look at the proportions of this timber roof!

meanings.note: Pinyin: suì. Measure word for age; follows numbers directly without 个 (八十岁 'eighty years old').

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

examples.text: 这位老木匠今年七十岁了。
examples.trans: This veteran carpenter is seventy years old this year.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bù. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块布 ('a piece of cloth').

examples.text: 周经理，给您干净布和冷水。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou, here is a clean cloth and cold water for you.

examples.text: 请拿一块干净的布擦桌子。
examples.trans: Please take a clean cloth to wipe the table.

related.gloss: a piece of cloth (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kāi. Versatile verb for opening doors, starting business, turning on taps/lights, or water boiling.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 当然不能偷看……咦，自己翻开在中间那页了！
examples.trans: Of course we must not peek... oh, it fell open to the middle page by itself!

张.gloss: measure word for flat surfaces and paper

meanings.en: measure word for flat surfaces and paper
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhāng. Counts tables, beds, paper sheets, tickets, receipts, and luggage tags (一张桌子, 一张纸).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 旁边的把手上系着一张小纸牌。
examples.trans: There is a small paper card tied on the side handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hěn. Links a subject to a simple predicate adjective without needing 是 (今天很冷 'It is cold today').

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáng qǐ lái. Literally 'think up-come': a memory coming back to mind (我想起来了 'now I remember').

examples.text: 我想起来了！我十岁的时候，叔叔叫它冬天茶室！
examples.trans: Now I remember! When I was ten, my uncle called it the winter tea room!

examples.text: 我想起来了，钥匙在抽屉里！
examples.trans: Now I remember, the key is in the drawer!

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ men. First-person plural pronoun; add 的 for 'our' (我们的).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng zi. Measure word (量词): 栋 (dòng), e.g. 一栋房子 ('a house').

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 老房子每到星期二就松一颗螺丝。坐吧。
examples.trans: Every Tuesday an old house loosens one screw. Sit down.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng jiān. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房间 ('a room').

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: suó yǐ. Introduces a result or conclusion, often after 因为.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 分贝？所以九分不是给我前台服务打的分？
examples.trans: Decibels? So nine points was not a score for my front-desk service?

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房今天到。
examples.trans: Right, eight guest rooms, eight brass keys. Room four arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng. Everyday verb for placing an object somewhere (放在桌子上).

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo shang. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个早上 ('a morning').

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí hou. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 这个时候 ('this moment').

examples.text: 下雨的时候，纸不会弄丢房间名单。
examples.trans: When it rains, paper will not lose the room list.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chūn tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个春天 ('a spring season').

examples.text: 五分钟演讲稿，列了十九条理由解释那年春天我们都错了。
examples.trans: A five-minute speech listing nineteen reasons why we were both wrong that spring.

examples.text: 春天一到，院子里的老树就发新芽了。
examples.trans: As soon as spring arrives, the old courtyard tree puts out fresh shoots.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shù. Measure word (量词): 棵, e.g. 一棵树 ('a tree').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 只有院子里的老树和雨声。
examples.trans: Only the old tree in the courtyard and the sound of rain.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuō zi. Measure word (量词): 张 (zhāng), e.g. 一张桌子 ('a table').

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuǐ. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯水 ('a glass of water').

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

examples.text: 我刚试了洗手池水龙头，水先是温的，马上变凉了。
examples.trans: I just tested the sink tap—the water started warm, then turned cool right away.

related.gloss: a glass of water (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: méi. Short form of 没有; negates 有 and past/completed actions (没锁 'isn't locked / didn't lock').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.en: not have; there is not; did not
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi yǒu. Negates 有 ('have / there is') and past actions.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dī. Used as a verb ('drip') or measure word for drops of liquid.

examples.text: 天哪！桌子上一滴没洒……全洒在我领带上了！
examples.trans: Good heavens! Not a drop spilled on the table... it all spilled on my tie!

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: piào liang. Praises attractive rooms or a job done with flair.

examples.text: 三分钟就能送上三楼。今天跑得漂亮，搭档。
examples.trans: Three minutes to reach the third floor. Fine run today, partner.

examples.text: 这盘金黄色的柠檬蛋糕做得真漂亮！
examples.trans: This plate of golden lemon cake turned out beautifully!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lòu. Used for leaking pipes or roofs (漏水) and omitted items.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

examples.text: 一滴水都不漏！现在可以点着热水器了吗？
examples.trans: Not a single drop leaking! Can we light the water heater now?

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè. Describes hot tea, hot water, or warm weather.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bō li. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块玻璃 ('a pane of glass').

examples.text: 小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
examples.trans: Qing, look through the glass—the two of them are standing face to face under the tree!

examples.text: 擦干净玻璃窗以后，屋里亮多了。
examples.trans: After wiping the glass window clean, the room is much brighter.

related.gloss: a pane of glass (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bái. Describes white paper, sugar, or tablecloths.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 看，把手上贴着一个白信封。
examples.trans: Look, there is a white envelope taped onto the handle.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: kàn. Covers looking at something, reading silently, or visiting someone; add 见/到 for 'catch sight of'.

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块石头 ('a stone').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 等等，低头看石头台阶上。
examples.trans: Wait—look down on the stone step.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇窗 ('a window').

examples.text: 一点也不介意！窗下这张宽书桌正适合我工作。
examples.trans: Not at all! And this wide desk beneath the window suits my work ideally.

examples.text: 打开木窗就能看见院子里的老树。
examples.trans: Open the wooden window and you can see the old tree in the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chuāng bǎn. Measure word (量词): 扇 (shàn), e.g. 一扇窗板 ('a shutter').

examples.text: 外面的窗板都关着，所以在院子里谁也没发现！
examples.trans: The shutters outside are all closed, so nobody in the courtyard ever noticed!

examples.text: 还有六天：擦玻璃，刷窗板，烤柠檬蛋糕！
examples.trans: Six days left: clean the glass, paint the shutters, bake lemon cake!

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng. Everyday verb for waiting (等一下 'wait a moment').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dā ying. Means agreeing to a request or giving one's word.

examples.text: 让我猜猜，你把没有的房间答应给别人了？
examples.trans: Let me guess: you promised someone a room we do not have?

examples.text: 既然答应了别人，就一定要准时做到。
examples.trans: Once you give someone your word, be sure to follow through on time.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīng lǐ. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位经理 ('a manager').

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: néng. Expresses practical ability or whether circumstances allow something (能睡个好觉).

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯茶 ('a cup of tea').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

related.gloss: a cup of tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá shì. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间茶室 ('a tea room').

examples.text: 我想起来了！我十岁的时候，叔叔叫它冬天茶室！
examples.trans: Now I remember! When I was ten, my uncle called it the winter tea room!

examples.text: 下午，客人们喜欢在茶室里聊天。
examples.trans: In the afternoon, guests like to chat in the tea room.

meanings.en: want; need; will / be going to
meanings.note: Pinyin: yào. Direct verb for ordering/requesting ('want'), obligation ('need to'), or imminent future (要下雨了).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiǎo luò. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个角落 ('a corner').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 为小院客栈干杯——成都最热闹的安静角落！
examples.trans: Cheers to Courtyard Inn—the liveliest quiet corner in Chengdu!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dú shū. Combines 读 ('read') with 书 ('book'); also means 'to be at school'. Before a noun it means 'for reading' (读书咖啡馆 'reading café').

examples.text: 等等——为了保护老房子，我们答应过城里开读书咖啡馆！
examples.trans: Wait—to protect the old house, we promised the city a reading café!

examples.text: 她每天晚上都在床上读书。
examples.trans: She reads in bed every evening.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí. Question pronoun for people; stays in the exact spot of the answer (这是谁的？ 'Whose is this?').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: guò. Read neutral-tone guo after a verb for 'have ever done' (见过); read guò as a verb meaning 'cross/pass' (过河 'cross the river').

examples.text: 早跟你说过，那个平板是个坑。
examples.trans: Told you before, that tablet is a trap.

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè me. Proximal degree adverb (这么快 'this fast', 这么重 'so heavy').

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

examples.text: 这么快就修好了？老陈你随身带着螺丝刀啊！
examples.trans: Fixed that fast? Chen, you carry a screwdriver everywhere on you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè xiē. Plural of 这个, needing no extra measure word before the noun.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 你们这些好人真是救了我这趟旅行。
examples.trans: You kind people have truly saved this whole trip of mine.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè yàng. Points to a manner or result close at hand; at the start of a clause it means 'that way, so that' (这样就轻了 'that way it gets light').

examples.text: 先拿最上面一层，这样书架就轻了。
examples.trans: Take the top shelf first, so the bookcase gets lighter.

examples.text: 城里那封信要的，就是这样一个房间！
examples.trans: And this is exactly the room the city letter asked for!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè lǐ. Standard location pronoun meaning 'here' (spoken variant 这儿).

examples.text: 这里就是梧桐巷十二号。
examples.trans: Right here is Number Twelve, Wutong Lane.

examples.text: 请在这里签上您的名字。
examples.trans: Please sign your name right here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 笔 (bǐ), e.g. 一笔钱 ('a sum of money').

examples.text: 怎么样？他发火了吗？要退钱吗？
examples.trans: How did it go? Did he lose his temper? Did he ask for a refund?

examples.text: 买黄油和牛奶一共花了十二块钱。
examples.trans: Buying butter and milk cost twelve yuan altogether.

related.gloss: a sum of money (measure word 笔)

meanings.note: Pinyin: suǒ. Works as both verb ('lock the door' 锁门) and noun ('a lock' 一把锁).

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǔ. Measure word (量词): 场 (chǎng), e.g. 一场雨 ('a rain').

examples.text: 晚上好！先生，快进来避避雨吧。
examples.trans: Good evening! Sir, come inside quickly out of the rain.

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bāo. Measure word (量词): 片 (piàn), e.g. 一片面包 ('a slice of bread').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
examples.trans: Smell that! Warm bread, hot scrambled eggs, and fresh herbs.

related.gloss: a slice of bread (measure word 片)

meanings.note: Pinyin: fēng. Measure word (量词): 阵, e.g. 一阵风 ('a gust of wind').

examples.text: 热汤？在冷站台吹了风，喝碗热汤太好了。
examples.trans: Hot soup? After the cold wind on the station platform, hot soup sounds wonderful.

examples.text: 春天下午的风又轻又暖。
examples.trans: The spring afternoon breeze is gentle and warm.

related.gloss: a gust of wind (measure word 阵)

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāo. Describes tall people, high ceilings, or high scores.

examples.text: 让我好好看看你，志豪！你长得比钢琴还高了！
examples.trans: Let me look at you properly, Zhihao! You grew taller than the piano!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?
